description: Tüm İsbike İstasyonları Web Servisi is a dataset listed in Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality open data portal, a city open data portal (CKAN), published or maintained by İSPARK Inc.. Bu metot ile İsbike uygulaması üzerinde hizmet veren tüm istasyonların durum bilgilerini görüntülenebilir. Bu servis geçici olarak kullanıma kapatılmıştır. Coverage: İSPARK Inc.. The publisher named on the listing is İSPARK Inc.. Its keywords include api, isbike, isbike istasyonu, ispark, istasyon, mekansal veri. The listing shows 3 download or service links in API, PDF. The listing shows 2026-02-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Istanbul Metropolitan Municipality Open Data License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-data-ibb-gov-tr.
